t: What Coordinate Reference System Database Is All About
title: What Coordinate Reference System Database Is All About
description: CRS is the Earth's addressing: WGS84 (the GPS: EPSG:4326), UTM (the projected zones), State Plane (the US local), and vertical datums (NAVD88: the height). The trap: mixing datums (the 100m error). The transform: PROJ. The rule: know your CRS; transform explicitly.
